_comment: Global agent-level event routing. Single source of truth for event-to-task routing.

_schema.routing_key: Legacy shorthand: dot-path to extract from event, auto-compared to task.id / skill.id
_schema.match_fields: Array of {event_path, task_path|literal, transform?} — declarative multi-field matching
_schema.match_mode: 'all' (default, AND) or 'any' (OR) — controls how match_fields pairs combine
_schema.transforms: lower, upper, strip, str, int, prefix:<X>, suffix:<X>

_example_match_fields._note: Route websocket order updates to the task whose state.account_id matches the event's data.account_id

_example_timer_routing._note: Timer routes are auto-generated by _amend_event_routing_for_task using composite key 'timer:<name>'. The literal field matches event value against a static string.
